last_result.headline: Q41 closed. BLOCKER: honest+frontier cannot be validated -- the frontier exists locally only as test-set CSVs with no truth. On the honest family, 355 ensemble arms: nested +0.3346 helping 58.8% of wells (two of three gate conditions pass, the best yet) but 3-well 5th -1.3687, so FAIL. 0 of 355 arms have a positive 3-well 5th, and the 5th is MAXIMISED by changing the deployed line least -- monotonically in both directions. The variance hypothesis behind this task is refuted. The apparent gain is member substitution, not ensembling: ensembling adds only +0.0086 over the best single member. Recorded not recommended: topk96_l75 is +0.3556 on OOF and never submitted, but fails the same gate.
